overall_summary: The channel heavily focuses on 'self respect' and 'overthinking' digital breakup tropes, but these niche relationship shorts are currently generating very low views (0-41 views). Conversely, a minor out-of-niche experiment focusing on family emotions (Maa, Papa, Bhai) achieved significantly higher views (88-214 views), though it represents an outlier. Confidence is low due to small sample sizes across core topics.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about parents/family (e.g., Maa video 'माँ जब पूछती है' got 214 views, Papa video got 117 views) heavily outperformed core relationship content.
winning_patterns.action: Reserve a small experiment budget to test family-centric emotional bonds combined with the channel's diary style.

weak_patterns.evidence: Numerous shorts about phone settings, deleting chats, blocking, and removing ringtones (e.g., 'Read receipts off', 'Special ringtone') are averaging single-digit to low double-digit views (0-29 views).
weak_patterns.action: Move away from hyper-specific smartphone settings tropes as they are failing to pull organic reach; pivot toward broader emotional loneliness and self-respect.
